summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all major requirements: secret classification (expired/warning/ok), report generation, markdown/JSON output formats, error handling, and full CI/CD pipeline validation via act. Unit tests exercise core functions with deterministic reference dates and fixtures; workflow tests verify YAML structure, actionlint compliance, and end-to-end execution through GitHub Actions. Notable strengths: boundary condition testing (expiry at exact deadline, window edge), precise expected output validation, and multi-format verification. Minor gaps: no tests for empty secrets array, large-scale scenarios, special characters in names, missing requiredBy field defaulting, or invalid ReferenceDate rejection. Act tests are sophisticated but introduce complexity and environmental dependencies (Docker, powershell-yaml module, actionlint availability). Would reliably catch most regressions but depends on specific fixture content and external tools.
